verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the evidence is CSV upload, which pushes many records at once. It covers custom compliance resources (normalized, mapped, and tested by Secureframe) and user data for access reviews. Nothing shows bulk actions on existing items such as mass edit, assign, close, or delete, and the API and MCP evidence describe only per-object access, not batch endpoints. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete of existing items in the UI, batch API or MCP operations, documentation of bulk-action limits or behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
